name: Meihen
source:
The protagonist Uni has lost her memory and is trying to figure out why she is living in the dorm of a magic school.
She promised the principle of the academy that she would become independent before the end of December.
What path will she choose?
translation:
主人公尤妮失去了记忆，正试图弄清自己为什么会住在魔法学校的宿舍里。
她向学院校长承诺，会在12月底前变得独立。
她会选择哪条道路？
